class.name: MaszynaBTFTerrainProvider
class.brief_description: The terrain of the original's binary terrain file (.btf), supplied section by section.
class.description: The "triangles" of a text terrain file (.txtf) the original converted to binary and arranged by its 1 km sections, supplied section by section as the camera comes near. A section's shapes are merged as the original merges them: a translucent shape, or one seen only within a range, in a chunk per texture and range around its cell's centre; the others by texture over the whole section. The original takes the binary file in place of its text when it was made from that text, or alone.

method.name: get_source_length
method.description: The length of the text the file at [param path] was made from, which the original checks it against its .txtf by; [code]-1[/code] when the file is no binary terrain file of the version and layout the original writes.

method.name: open
method.description: Lists the materials and sections of the file at [param path], without reading the sections; [code]false[/code] when it is no binary terrain file. [param translucency] tells a translucent material by its name ([code]MaszynaMaterialManager.is_material_translucent()[/code]): only the opaque shapes are merged over a whole section.
